_about: Solo-tuned AI stats for the Skyglass treasure hunts (engine/hunts.ts). Keys are live AI ids; pools = poolsMultiplier, rows = innate +100% damage-given rows (each capped at 100 by the engine, rows multiply), stats = statsMultiplier where changed from live. Crown Archivist (Archive alarm guard) and the Called to the Archive summon (Crown Stonebound: echoHp, echoPower) per RUL-2026-10-28-013.
_final_pass: fable/skyglass-final-sim: Watch Captain 2/4 -> 2.5/1 + 10% givenDown (the phase-1 duel killed a solo player by round 3-9: 7/40); Foundry Warden 2.5/1 -> 3.5/1 (97.5% -> target 80%); Cache Sentinel 3/3 -> 3/4 (RUL-2026-10-28-021: boss ~20% HP); echoPower 60 -> 40 (RUL-2026-10-28-026 item 3).
_rul060: RUL-2026-10-30-060 item 1: The Captain's solo pools 2.5 -> 3 (1 damage row and 10% damage given down unchanged). Otherwise identical to overrides/hunts.params.json (final pass).
_rul067_probe: RUL-2026-10-31-067 feasibility probe: the Skyglass Sentinel at the Haul steps-4-5 values (haul.ts g-veteran: stats 3, pools 1.2, 3 rows, 100% taken).
